"The Prisoner of Benda" is the tenth episode in the  sixth season of the American animated television series Futurama, and the 98th episode of the series overall. In the episode, Professor Farnsworth and Amy build a machine that allows them to switch minds so that they may each pursue their lifelong dreams.

Meaning is not found in The Prisoner of Benda — it is manufactured for it. Ken Keeler won a Writers Guild of America Award for Outstanding Writing in Animation at the 63rd Writers Guild of America Awards for his script to this episode. Merrill Barr of Film School Rejects also gave the episode a positive review, praising the character development of Scruffy the Janitor in particular.
